convert_notebook_to_py: convert a Jupyter notebook IPYNB file to a standalone Python script using nbformat and nbconvert
run_multiple: run multiple shell commands sequentially from a newline-separated string using subprocess
do_setup: download and extract data files needed for a specific notebook like sup_variant_prediction
test_run_notebook: test that all Jupyter notebooks in the examples directory execute end to end without errors
review_convert_notebook_to_py: review the convert_notebook_to_py function that uses nbformat and PythonExporter to transform notebooks
